name: mirage
text: Found it: the engine's key #2 reads as PRO (100,000-credit plan); the others are 2 Starter and 7 free keys. The engine's key pool already sends the paid key first once it has read the plan, so the bigger allowance is used from the next hourly plan read. Now running the probe job on GitHub (about 60 credits) to capture REAL answers from live play-by-play SSE, arbs, book latency and live period markets.
